name: Emboar-EX vs Togekiss-EX Battle Starter Set

releases.name: Emboar-EX vs Togekiss-EX Battle Starter Set

description.text: Battle Start Set 30: Emboar-EX VS Togekiss-EX, released on 18 July 2015 for players starting to battle with Pokémon-EX: two ready-built 30-card half decks, one led by Emboar-EX and one by Togekiss-EX, with a playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers, a rule book and a player's guide, so two people could play straight away.
